name: Paracas
blurb: Paracas features coastal desert landscapes where sand meets the Pacific Ocean, alongside the Paracas National Reserve and Ballestas Islands. Visitors frequently highlight local wildlife viewing including sea lions, Humboldt penguins, and diverse bird species.

positive: Great wildlife viewing including penguins and sea lions
Scenic coastal desert landscapes and reserves
Enjoyable boat tours to the Ballestas Islands
negative: Walking all the way home from Paracas is discouraged
Critique of colonial naming for the Candelabra geoglyph

quotes.text:
Day trips that blow minds:  

• Paracas + Ballestas Islands (sea lions & penguins)  
• Huacachina desert oasis (sandboarding!)  
• Pachacámac ruins

Did ya catch our video last week? We head out to the Ballestas Islands, Peru’s “Mini Galapagos,” and then to Paracas National Preserve, where the desert meets the ocean!

Paracas birding was great! Humboldt Penguin, Blackish Oystercatcher, Peruvian Tern, Peruvian Pelican and Peruvian Booby* Belcher’s Gull, about a million Inca Terns, and Red-Legged and Guanay Cormorants!
